text_block_list.text:
One day, while Mejiro Ryan was weight 
training at the gym—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Guhh... It hits the spot~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My biceps are, like, thrilling with 
energy...! This is the true joy of barbell 
training!
choice_data_list: That looks like it feels great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Lately, I've been doing nothing but 
running laps, so I've been neglecting my 
upper body strength training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'm going to take my sweet time 
tending mainly to your arms, shoulders, 
and back—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Strength training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know I gotta do it right, but... when 
it's tough, it's tough, y'know~...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Excuse me, Trainer. I'll be right 
back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature-chan! If you'd like— would you 
want to train together with me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-Ryan-senpai...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, just a little more effort! Here 
we go! Twenty-eight!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, it's finally over~! I can't do 
this ever again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, good job! Those were some nice 
push-ups!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Upper body muscles are vital both for 
pumping your arms and maintaining your 
core while running. That's why strength 
training is—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
An important thing... Well, the teacher 
said so too, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But that's just the theory. When it 
comes to strength training, you have to 
feel it with your body first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Don't you feel it right now? That 
Nature-chan's brachialis muscles are 
completely overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My brachialis muscle is... rejoicing...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, haha. What are you talking about? 
The only thing I'm feeling is tired, at 
most――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? I'm tired, but... it kind of 
feels nice somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right? If all you do is run, the muscles 
you don't use get jealous and start 
sulking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Just give it some proper attention, 
though... and it'll cheer right up, just 
like it did now!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, saying your muscles are 'in good 
spirits' is a bit... I mean, it's not a 
bad thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. That's the fun of muscle training! 
I'll teach you plenty more!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, maybe just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, next up would be—
choice_data_list:
Let's push ourselves to the absolute 
limit!
First, allow me to teach you the theory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! The essence of muscle 
training is surpassing your own limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I don't learn my limits today... My 
tomorrow self won't be able to surpass 
them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Nature-chan. Things are going to get a 
bit tough, but can you keep up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Limits?! Whoa whoa, I'm totally fine just 
taking things in moderation, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, don't worry, leave it to me! 
Come on, let's do it together!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One for muscle, all for muscle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: One for muscle, all for muscle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Eh? No, I just ended up yelling, but... 
Wh-What is that...?

To keep pushing past their own limits... 
The challenge of these two will continue 
on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Proper muscle training must begin 
with proper theory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's go, you two. First off, 
we'll start by memorizing the names and 
locations of all the muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The muscle moving right now is... the 
rhomboid!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes! Rhomboid muscle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And over here is... the erector spinae!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: E-Erector spinae muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! All my muscles are singing 
with joy~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No. What in the world am I 
doing...?"

Word has it that Mejiro Ryan-style muscle 
training became a famous fixture at the 
gym for quite a while.
